entries.text: This scan found 20 open issues on 20 elements across all 5 pages checked: 3 critical and 17 serious. Start with the footer social icon row in src/Shell.jsx (lines 30-32): those links are icon-only, and the icons are hidden from screen readers, so the links announce nothing to anyone using one. They repeat on every page, and one fix there clears all 15 of them at once. After that, the low-contrast text on two pages, then the image with no description, the unlabeled form field, and the dropdown with no name.
